SELECT T1."XCL_019" FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1."XCL_021" = T2."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN alignment AS T3 ON T1."XCL_027" = T3."XCL_001"

  AND T3."XCL_002" = 'Bad'

ORDER BY T4."XCL_011" DESC
LIMIT 1
